name: pda
description: PDA — a multi-workspace journaling app with rich-text blocks, tasks, custom properties, semantic search, AI summaries, and an MCP server. Next.js 14 + Supabase.

overridesNote.jsdom: jsdom is pulled in transitively by isomorphic-dompurify (lib/sanitize) and must stay below 27.4: from 27.4 on, jsdom requires the ESM-only @exodus/bytes from its own CommonJS files, which relies on Node's require(ESM) support that the Next.js server runtime on Vercel does not implement. Every server route reaching jsdom then threw ERR_REQUIRE_ESM at import time and returned 500 — most visibly /api/mcp. isomorphic-dompurify only ever calls `new JSDOM('<!DOCTYPE html>')`, so the older major is a drop-in. It is also declared as a direct dependency so npm hoists it to the top level: nested under isomorphic-dompurify it no longer matches Next's server-external-packages list, and webpack bundles it into the route, where jsdom's readFileSync of default-stylesheet.css fails the build. Remove both once the Next runtime supports require(ESM).
